about: Rearms after uses in the real game: a stats edit gives the Orbital Railcannon Strike 3 mission uses that rearm after a 30 s cooldown; with it in the loadout before the mission, three calls land 20 s apart (each once the previous strike has finished: the game holds a stratagem while its strike runs), the uses left the HUD shows go 3, 2, 1, 0, a fourth call waits, the uses come back to 3 after the cooldown, and a call lands again (tests/in-game/README.md).
